text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand introduced me to her 
childhood friend from her Junior Club 
days.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
According to her, Cheval Grand had been 
earnest since she was young, quietly and 
steadily putting in the work in her 
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Transferring clubs later on was also so 
she could practice without worrying about 
her sisters, and draw closer to the "great 
Umamusume" who had defeated the "Hero."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a Trainer, I wanted to prove the 
strength of Cheval Grand, who continues to 
push forward and choose her own path.
